label: Verified Fact
description: A claim classification for statements intended to be maintained as verifiable facts; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Supported Interpretation
description: A claim classification for reasoned interpretations supported by identified material; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Practitioner Evidence
description: A claim classification for practitioner-derived observations or case-based evidence; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Policy Proposition
description: A claim classification for a policy proposal or option under evaluation; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Working Hypothesis
description: A claim classification for a hypothesis being tested or refined; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Unresolved Question
description: A claim classification for a question that remains unresolved; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Legal Interpretation
description: A claim classification for a legal or regulatory interpretation requiring careful sourcing and qualification; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Statistical Claim
description: A claim classification for quantitative or statistical assertions; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.

label: Comparative Claim
description: A claim classification for comparison across jurisdictions, models or cohorts; classification alone does not determine evidence status or publication approval.
